title: Fork the Rook
setup: Black's rook has crept to c8, close to its king. You are an exchange down, but one pawn up.
hint: Find the square that checks the king and attacks c8 at the same time. It is one hop away.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Nd6+}} attacks the king on e8 and the rook on c8 at once. No black pawn stands on c7 or e7 to guard d6, so the knight is safe. {{Kd7}} guards the rook, but {{Nxc8}} takes it anyway, and after {{Kxc8}} the rooks and knights are gone. What is left is a pawn ending with your extra pawn.

A fork that only wins the exchange can still be enough, when it leads to an ending you can win.
